source_text.body:
Have an agent request songs in a desktop music player
The author used agent-browser to control the VutronMusic desktop player over CDP, with the AI recognizing interface elements and automatically requesting a song.
·
Nov 11, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The author turned on the remote debugging port of VutronMusic, an Electron desktop player. agent-browser then connected to the app over CDP, the Chrome DevTools Protocol. The AI identified the interface elements and carried out the song request on its own. The page is a short summary that links to the original Linux.do post.
How it went
The experiment worked: the AI recognized the player's interface and requested a song automatically. The summary gives no numbers, and it doesn't cover failures or limits.
Worth knowing
The app must be launched with its remote debugging port open so the agent can attach over CDP. The summary doesn't give the exact steps, so check the original post.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
Open the music player app [app name] on my desktop and find and play the song [song title by artist], using the search box and play button. Tell me what you see at each step. Stop once the song is playing and confirm the title shown on screen matches what I asked for.
Original source: https://www.80aj.com/2026/03/17/ai-agent-music-player/
